summary_en: This study tests pirtobrutinib in people with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL). The drug is taken by mouth, with three dose levels tested in Part 1; how often doses are taken is not stated. Part 1 is expected to last about 3 years and Part 2 up to 2 years, and the study assesses efficacy and safety, but the specific main outcome measure is not stated; it is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pirtobrutinib en personas con leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC) o linfoma linfocítico de células pequeñas (LLPC) en recaída o refractarios. El medicamento se toma por vía oral, con tres dosis diferentes probadas en la Parte 1; la frecuencia de las dosis no se indica. La Parte 1 dura unos 3 años y la Parte 2 hasta 2 años, y el estudio evalúa la eficacia y la seguridad, aunque la medida de resultado principal específica no se indica; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Confirmed chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma under iwCLL 2018 criteria.
Part 1: 1 to 3 prior lines of CLL/SLL treatment, including a covalent BTK inhibitor.
Part 2: no prior CLL/SLL treatment and a 17p deletion.
Need for therapy under iwCLL 2018 criteria.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and able to swallow oral medication.
not_for: Prior treatment with a BTK degrader or a noncovalent BTK inhibitor.
Grade 3 or higher bleeding caused by a BTK inhibitor.
Known or suspected central nervous system involvement by CLL/SLL.
Another cancer within 3 years before randomization, with some exceptions.
